messages:
paul (Controller): Noticed AWS marketplace payout reconciliation shows 'unmatched credits' for reseller partner BlueHarbor for Q1. Amount ~12,250 USD. Looks like they issued credits for beta promos but we don't have corresponding documentation. Who can help triage?
mei (Billing): referencing payout file: /finance/marketplace/payouts/AWSPayouts-Q1-2026.csv. Line 102: partner=blueharbor, adjustment_type=credit, amount=12250, reason=promo. No promo id.
tara (Partner Ops): BlueHarbor sometimes issues 'channel promo' credits to end-customers under a different promo id. We need the partner's credit memos or promo code mapping to reconcile.
irfan (Revenue Management): If we can't match, this will hold settlement and create a variance on the marketplace ledger. We should ask partner for credit memos and list of impacted customers.
settlement-bot: Reconciliation job 2026-04-12T03:00Z. Status: PARTIAL. Unmatched adjustments: 1 (blueharbor: 12250).
mei (Billing): I'll open portal ticket with BlueHarbor asking for credit memos, promo ids, and list of customer guids impacted. Tara can you cc partner-ops contact?
tera (Partner Ops): small typo in Mei's comment - that's tara, I got it. I'll cc partner_ops@cloud for BlueHarbor.
paul (Controller): Also pls confirm if credits were reflected at customer AR level. If not, we need to decide recognition treatment.
mei (Billing): Running AR match now... none of the credits appear against AR ledger. Looks like partner applied credits on their side but didn't submit credit memos to us.
tara (Partner Ops): Pinged rep. Response: "processing paperwork, will upload memos within 3 business days." I'll follow up if not received.
irfan (Revenue Management): Ok hold settlement for BlueHarbor until memos arrive. Paul - I'll prepare variance memo for audit trail.
paul (Controller): Thanks. Also flag on next month close: if memos don't arrive, we'll need to estimate and book a provisioning entry.
mei (Billing): Ticket created: PM-4571. Link: internal ticket tracker. Will update thread when memos uploaded. :mag_right:
